description: Generates a new RSA signing key for this configuration. overlap=true keeps the previous key published for the configured window; false removes every earlier key immediately. Needs Pro or Enterprise (or Vetted assurance); rate limited per configuration. Returns the current kid and published keys.

configuration_id.description: The configuration id (from create_tenant or get_tenant).

overlap.description: true keeps the previous key for the overlap window; false drops all earlier keys immediately.

name: rotate_signing_key
